item.content:encoded:
Welcome to the Sports Zone, population me. I literally do not know anything about rugby, but that doesn't really matter, because the game itself rarely comes into play. If you see any Glaring Rugby Errors then comment below and I might fix them.

A lot of the little bits in this article were contributed by GreenWolf, ARandomDay, and other people in the Third Law chat, and also my roommates. Crit credits mainly go to GreenWolf, ARandomDay, and Taffeta. Apologies to the professional wrestlers, real-life Reed students and faculty, and historical figures whose names have been remixed and/or just used straight up for this article. I would also like to specifically thank one of my roommates, Color Antivirus, for being Indigo Norton's real-life counterpart.

Part Two coming, like they say in the article, approximately next Friday. Unless I finish it before then.
